en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a coastal town with low, veranda-style buildings among many palm trees, near the shoreline. The upper portion contains the photograph, while the lower portion is blank for writing. Red printed captions identify the view as 'Mossamedes – Vista Geral', and a vertical publisher credit appears along the left margin.
